- Premises re-run, all hold at the same numbers: `ui/AGENTS.md` is 261 lines / 36,089 bytes; 27 lines carry ⛔ or "never"; those lines alone are 16,789 bytes (positive control `pnpm` → 20 lines). One correction to premise 3's last-touch: `git log -1 origin/main -- ui/AGENTS.md` → `8bb2c31b` 2026-10-28T13:18Z, not `3d50a43bc`; the byte count is unchanged, so the conflict stands — 16,789 bytes exceed 10 KB before a single pointer line is written.
- Prior rulings: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 27297` names ADR-0131 D3 / D13 (organization ownership), ADR-0076 D9–D11, ADR-0005 §5, ADR-0029 D9.7, ADR-0058 D3 — term matches, none rules on an instruction file's size. Thread: 6407900763 item 1 carries both prescriptions (a core of at most 10 KB, and every ⛔ / never rule kept verbatim in it); 6435359095 dispatches PR 2 under it. The 10 KB figure's provenance is as the card states: cloud#3194's ruling 6385321890, sized for cloud's own file, carried to `ui/` as an execution parameter by a seat.
- Facets: agree with the card on all four. ① the invariant is "every hard prohibition is read on every session"; the byte cap is a proxy for it and was borrowed from another file. ③ breaks the tie against B: a prohibition that moved to a topic page fails silently when the page is not opened. ④ none of the three options adds a gate or a number to keep.
- Seat's letter: **A** — every ⛔ / never line stays whole and verbatim in the core; the 10 KB figure is dropped and the core's size is whatever those lines plus one pointer line per topic page come to. The dev measures that size before editing and reports it (the card's ~20 KB is 未实测). Not B (keeps the borrowed number, gives up the invariant it approximates). Not C (splits lines against the same ruling's "no sentence reworded", doubles upkeep per split).
- Workload of A: `domain:devx` · 1 Tier H PR + contract review · M · no precedent for a core restructure in this repository (PR 1, #26023, was housekeeping).
- After the ruling: the devx seat moves #25919 `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` and dispatches PR 2 under 6435359095 with this card's letter on a `Ruling-ref:` line; the PR body shows the 27-line census before and after.

Prior rulings read: core, verbatim, 10 KB, never → ADR term matches only (none on an instruction file's size); thread: 6407900763, 6435359095 on #25919; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

Not taken: B (keeps a borrowed number and gives up the invariant it approximates), C (splits lines against the same ruling's "no sentence reworded", doubles upkeep per split).

Governing text: 6407900763 item 1 and 6435359095 on #25919; cloud#3194 ruling 6385321890. Premises re-read at `origin/main` `6d7634a9` (brief 6485463740): `ui/AGENTS.md` 36,089 bytes / 261 lines; 27 ⛔ / never lines; 16,789 bytes in those lines alone.

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:devx` · 1 Tier H PR + contract review · M · no precedent for a core restructure in this repository (PR 1, #26023, was housekeeping).

① 长远：守住「每条硬性禁令每个会话必读」这个真不变量；10 KB 是借来的代理数，不是契约
② 拉动：每个 ui 会话加载 36 KB 且含已证伪指令；A 砍约 45%
③ 防错：规则恒在必读上下文，违反可响亮拒收；B 会让搬走的 ⛔ 静默失效
④ 不扩散：只删字、不加门禁、不新增需长期守的数字
